Detailed Description

Author:
Ryan Daly rpdaly@ucsd.edu
Date:
03/04/2009 This file contains the definition of the mesh_t struct which contains all mesh information. It also contains constructors for all of the functions required to manipulate meshes, including adding nodes and simplices.

Definition in file mesh.h.

Function Documentation

int mesh_gen_convex_hull ( mesh_t *  mesh_in  ) 

Generate the convex hull of faces on a vertex set.

This algorithm fills the mesh_in->ufaces (unfinished faces array) with faces comprising a convex hull of the nodes in mesh_in->vertx. The variable dirv_in contains a vector normal to the plane to use to determine the initial vertex lying on the hull (which is required for the gift wrapping algorithm).

This is a shitty function; don't use it unless absolutely necessary.

This function generates an initial simplex on which to build the mesh and which includes the node with index nidx_in. It searches for an empty circumcircle involving vertex nidx_in.
